externalized_config.evidence: serve(port) accepts port as argument; can be set via env

secrets_management.evidence: production_transport.py reads token from env, not hardcoded
Token never written to logs (log_message suppressed)

persistent_storage.evidence: CachedStore is a cache layer; canonical truth is on disk
Verified in restart_consumer_test.py — all state persisted across restart

health_endpoint.item: Health endpoint is public (no auth required)
health_endpoint.evidence: Health check happens before auth check in do_GET

logging.evidence: production_transport.py writes chain-broken errors to sys.stderr
log_message() suppressed to prevent token leakage
Logs are plain text, not structured JSON
logging.remediation: Add structured JSON logging for production

metrics.evidence: GET /metrics endpoint returns io_count, event_count, fact_count, source_count, document_count
GET /metrics returns cache_stats: io_cache_size, list_cache_size, store_cache_size
SourceRegistry.stats() returns per-source health counts; /metrics includes source_count
Measured in load tests but not exposed as runtime metrics
metrics.remediation: Add histogram metrics to /metrics endpoint for runtime p50/p95/p99

graceful_shutdown.evidence: production_transport.py registers SIGTERM handler that calls server.shutdown() in a separate thread
ThreadingHTTPServer waits for threads to complete on shutdown
AppendOnlyStore.append() writes immediately (no buffering) — no flush needed

recovery.evidence: Verified in restart_consumer_test.py §12 — all state persisted
CachedStore lazily loads collections on first access

data_retention.evidence: D9: No update/delete APIs — all history preserved
D2: Versioned facts/events — old versions never deleted
write_blob() is idempotent — same content stored once
No retention policy — all data kept forever
data_retention.remediation: Add DATA_RETENTION_DAYS env var for archival/cleanup
